source_gap_resolutions.title: Composition of Mixtures
source_gap_resolutions.basis: CED supplies the mixture/purity framing. Teacher PPT U2 supplies percent-composition calculations, impurity reasoning, and purity checks. Zumdahl remains the chemistry reference.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Teach the CED relationship between elemental mass composition and mixture composition using PPT-level percent-composition and purity reasoning. Do not expand into additional mixture-analysis methods without a new source.

source_gap_resolutions.title: Intramolecular Force and Potential Energy
source_gap_resolutions.basis: CED requires the potential-energy-versus-internuclear-distance representation. Teacher PPT U8 directly teaches bond order, equilibrium bond length/internuclear distance, the minimum on the curve, bond strength, and bond energy. Zumdahl supplies chemistry support.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Include the required potential-energy curve and its minimum, bond length, and bond energy. Keep depth at the CED/PPT level.

source_gap_resolutions.title: Representations of Equilibrium
source_gap_resolutions.basis: CED explicitly requires a particulate model for reversible reactions at equilibrium. Teacher PPT U11 supplies dynamic-equilibrium and concentration/rate representations but does not directly supply the particulate model.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Teach the CED-required particulate representation at minimum CED depth. Do not claim the teacher PPT provides a broader particulate-model sequence.

source_gap_resolutions.title: Buffer Capacity
source_gap_resolutions.basis: CED defines the buffer-capacity relationships. Teacher PPT U12 supplies buffer composition and response to added acid/base. The Unit 8 scoring guide directly assesses how component concentration changes buffer capacity while the ratio and pH remain the same.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Teach capacity through concentration and conjugate-pair proportions at CED depth. Keep calculations limited to what the supplied instructional and assessment sources support.

source_gap_resolutions.title: pH and Solubility
source_gap_resolutions.basis: CED requires a qualitative pH-solubility relationship. Teacher PPT U13 supplies Ksp/common-ion and qualitative solubility reasoning, with supporting acid-base material from PPT U12.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Keep reasoning qualitative. Do not require computations of solubility as a function of pH.

source_gap_resolutions.title: Free Energy of Dissolution
source_gap_resolutions.basis: Teacher PPT U9 supplies the three energetic steps of solution formation. Teacher PPT U14 supplies free-energy, enthalpy, and entropy reasoning. CED supplies the integrated dissolution free-energy objective, with Zumdahl as chemistry reference.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Integrate the PPT solution-formation and thermodynamics material only to the CED objective. Do not add textbook-only dissolution thermodynamics beyond that scope.

source_gap_resolutions.title: Coupled Reactions
source_gap_resolutions.basis: No direct teacher-PPT treatment was located. CED requires external-energy and coupled-reaction reasoning, including shared intermediates and overall favorable free energy. Zumdahl 11e directly explains external-energy driving and coupled favorable/unfavorable reactions.
source_gap_resolutions.production_guard: Teach only the CED-required minimum using CED framing and Zumdahl-verified chemistry. Retain the missing teacher-depth source as a visible warning and do not add textbook-only depth.

remaining_warnings: Topic 9.7 has no direct teacher-PPT depth source. Production is bounded to the CED minimum and Zumdahl-verified chemistry until a teacher-depth source is supplied.
The seven F0B gap identifiers remain retained in audit history even where F0D defines a bounded production treatment.
